units.source_text: “在铁道省举办温泉展览会的时候，盖了个休息室或者建了间茶室，屋顶就是用这儿的芭茅草盖的。

en.t: When the Ministry of Railways held a hot springs exhibition, they built a rest area or perhaps a tea room, and the roof was thatched with kaya grass from here.

units.source_text: 据说东京来人把整座茶室都买下来了。”

en.t: They say someone from Tokyo bought the entire tea room outright.
